title: Roundtable № 02
question: Where does preventive care break down between recommended and completed in your setting?
for_whom: FQHC leadership and quality staff, care coordinators, community health workers, clinicians and programme managers.
anchor: Anchored to the Prevention Adoption Gap: colorectal screening reaches 44.89% at the average FQHC nationally and 48.74% in Michigan (CY2025 UDS), and 63.5% of U.S. adults against a Healthy People 2030 target of 72.8%.
